# VinylDeck
> Windows desktop app that renders the active system media session as a cinematic vinyl deck.

## Primary Docs
- `README.md`: public project overview, quick start, features, links
- `docs/USER_GUIDE.md`: user controls, settings, window modes
- `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`: system design and state ownership
- `docs/API.md`: Tauri command/event contracts
- `docs/DEVELOPMENT.md`: contributor setup and verification
- `docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md`: common runtime issues
- `docs/RELEASE_V1.md`: version notes and distribution checklist
- `CHANGELOG.md`: notable changes

## Core Concepts
- Browser mode uses `MockSource`.
- Tauri mode uses `TauriSource` over Rust SMTC commands and events.
- React consumes `PlaybackState`; Rust owns Windows media integration.
- Rust owns persisted settings and emits backend-approved settings snapshots.
- Start With Windows is a Rust-owned persisted setting backed by Tauri autostart.
- Mini Transparency is a Rust-owned persisted setting; it applies native Acrylic only to the Mini window.
- Active visual shells are Noir and Glass.
- CSS vinyl renderer is active.
- Album art drives ambient color and vinyl material styling.

## Important Paths
- `src/App.tsx`: app boot and render-mode routing
- `src/views/`: main and mini views
- `src/components/`: visual and interaction components
- `src/lib/playback/`: playback contracts, store, mock source, Tauri source
- `src/lib/settings/`: frontend settings adapter/cache
- `src-tauri/src/media/`: SMTC integration
- `src-tauri/src/settings/`: settings authority
- `src-tauri/src/window/`: window modes
- `src-tauri/src/tray.rs`: tray lifecycle

## Verification
```powershell
npm run build
npm run test:frontend
npm run fmt:rust
npm run clippy:rust
npm run test:rust
```
